policy: Compact backup: no raw static/motion PNGs, contact sheets, caches, duplicated full baseline or redundant validator reruns. Per-frame raw RGBA/file hashes and decode results retained. Original checksum manifests may name intentionally omitted diagnostic images.
reproducibility_limit: Raw native captures are not recoverable from the lossy MP4. Full historical frame-to-MP4 audit cannot be rerun from this compact package alone. New capture would need separate authorized native execution and new provenance.
